Big Hookr update goes live today:

Build your own @Uniswap v4 hook from Hook Blocks: proven hook legos you pick, tune and remix, no code needed. So far we had 6. This update adds 21 new Hook Blocks and tools.

Two ways to launch:
• Deploy your own hook with your Hook Blocks in one transaction, then submit it to Uniswap for verification
• Use Hookr's general hook with your chosen Blocks, with nothing to deploy.

Both work for new tokens and tokens that already exist.

What's better:
• Cheaper: swaps use about 47% to 70% less gas, launches about 40% less.
• Locked down: a pool's Hook Blocks are frozen at launch, and new ones wait in a timelock.
• More: up to 8 pools per token, half of arb profit back to LPs and traders, up to 3x rewards for locked LP, any quote asset.

The Hook Blocks:

Launching: Anti-Snipe, Multi-pool launch, Dev buy lock.
Trading: Dynamic fees, Arb recapture, King of the Pool, Market-hours fee.

For LPs: LP Rewards, Launch lock, LP Time-Lock Boost.
For creators and treasuries: Auto Burn, Creator royalty, Managed fee, Programs.

Launching later today:
• Deploy your own hook with your Hook Blocks in one transaction, then submit it to Uniswap for verification.
• Zero-seed and auction launches, Canonical Venue Token.
• Buy/Sell Block, Market Guard, Swap Reward Mint, Zap Relay.
• Entry Ratio Guarantee, Recovery reserve, Pay Later.
• Tax + Conversion, Revenue Router, Vesting Milestone, Floor bid, Dev Drip.
• Auction launches run on Uniswap's Continuous Clearing Auction.
• Partner tax and the Hook Blocks Market for third-party Hook Blocks.

Built to plug into Uniswap:
• Every Hookr pool is a Uniswap v4 pool
• Trades through the Universal Router, with the caller as the named trader
• HookrQuoter answers in V4Quoter's shape, same selectors, exact to the wei
• Auction launches run on Uniswap's Continuous Clearing Auction

For integrators:
• SDK: TypeScript on viem, builds every launch, swap, quote and claim
• Every contract verified on Blockscout and Sourcify
• Partner tax, referrals and the Hook Blocks Market for third-party Hook Blocks

Programs, referrals, the Managed fee and the Market-hours fee open in coming days.

👑💧King of the Pool:

Our new Hook Block: each round, the biggest buy on a pool takes the crown and wins a prize from a pot filled by arb recapture. Built with the What The Hook team, who also helped us update the UI. Huge shout out to them.

New team we're excited to start working with on custom hooks @PareStocks. They split a tokenized stock into two things you can trade separately. And we're working on some really cool custom Hook Blocks with every team. Lots more coming. Stay tuned.

This version is being submitted for an external audit.

Smart contract architecture:

tweets.text:
Quick Rundown of robinhood:0x18e674231a58c239dc7daedcffe15ec3a24cff5c (@Hookrfun)

About
Hookr is modular infrastructure for composing Uniswap v4 hooks on Robinhood Chain. Rather than launching into a generic pool, a creator picks up to five inspectable hook blocks and those rules are baked into the pool itself. The ETH/HOOKR pool was created on Aug 6 and the launch market has run since. Since Sep 17 it also runs arbitrage recapture, its first integration with an outside hook builder.

Key Figures (Sep 22)
🟪MCAP $15.3M, ATH $30.9M (Sep 4)
🟪TVL $12.8M, across 82 of 94 pools
🟪94 pools initialised
🟪116 tokens launched, 67 graduated
🟪5.16M HOOKR burned, 0.52% of supply

Metrics timeline
Holders: 3.3K (Aug 26) - 5.4K (Sep 1) - 6.8K (Sep 7) - 7.7K (Sep 18) - 7.8K (Sep 22)
Burned: 339K (Aug 21) - 1.4M (Aug 25) - 2.4M (Aug 29) - 3.5M (Sep 2) - 4.1M (Sep 10) - 5.2M (Sep 21)

Products
Hook Blocks
Hook blocks are the product. Five of them compose into one pool. Anti-Snipe caps early buys, adds an LP fee in the first blocks, and blocks exact-output buys so the cap cannot be routed around. Surge Fees scale the LP fee with how much of the pool's in-range depth a trade consumes, with no oracle dependency. Auto Burn sends a share of actual buy output to the dead address. LP Rewards streams a share of exact-input buys to in-range liquidity. Nth-Buy Pot fills a public counter that pays out to the buyer who triggers it, advancing at most once per pool per block.

Launch Paths
Launch paths come in two shapes. Instant Pool is a zero-seed launch at a fixed 2.5 ETH FDV, where the entire supply becomes one locked sell position and four of the blocks are available. Auction Launch reserves 20-50% of supply for the creator and sells the rest through Uniswap's Continuous Clearing Auction, with a 0.22 ETH default floor and a 1.1 ETH graduation threshold, and all five blocks available on ETH pairs.

Existing Asset Pairs
Existing-asset pairs opened the model past new launches. A hooked pool can be initialised on a token that already exists, permissionlessly, with no guard window and no founding position.

Hook Analyzer
Hook Analyzer is the screening layer. A pool, token, hook or swap transaction is pasted in and the custom hooks behind it are surfaced and analysed. Approved discoveries earn the finder HOOKR, and recurring on-chain royalties from approved integrations go to the verified original builder.

Lock Rewards
Lock Rewards pays the lock cohort. HOOKR locks fee-free for 30, 90 or 180 days at 1.00x, 1.15x and 1.25x weight, in Monday-to-Monday epochs, and pays out of realised Launch Boost fees collected while a position is eligible.

Launch Boost
Launch Boost is the placement mechanism. A launch creator locks HOOKR, which triggers a 1% fee routed to eligible Lock Rewards wallets. It opens two hours after deployment and is capped at 512 active entries.

Usage
Across the 116 launches, by hook block: Nth-Buy Pot 74, Anti-Snipe 65, Auto Burn 52, Surge Fees 48, LP Rewards 34.

Features
Hookr's hook approved by Uniswap and eligible for routing (Aug 31)
Hook Analyzer for surfacing and screening custom hooks (Aug 31)
Hooks on existing pairs, RWA pairs and post-launch liquidity (Sep 10)
Outlook range suggestions for liquidity placement (Sep 10)
Arbitrage recapture on launches and ETH-paired pools (Sep 17)

Partnerships and integrations
Hook integrators, contracts that run inside a Hookr pool's swap
@whatthehookv4 - arbitrage retention, live
@V4RCADE - gaming hooks, about to release

Launchpad and front-end integrators, products that open and manage Hookr markets from their own interface
@Perpshood - perp launcher, live

Hookr into others
Uniswap v4 - native hook, approved for routing
@0xzaps - founder's project, fees to HOOKR

Token Utility
Base fee
The base LP fee goes entirely to in-range LPs. The protocol takes a share only from opted-in add-ons, defaulting to 20% and capped at 50%: the surge surcharge splits 80% LPs and 20% protocol, the snipe tax 80% creator and 20% protocol, the LP-reward cut 80% LPs and 20% protocol, the Nth-buy pot 80% pot and 20% protocol, and Auto Burn burns 80% with 20% taken in quote.

ETH pairs
On ETH pairs a 0.3% protocol fee per swap accrues to the burner contract, which the owner spends on buybacks routed through the canonical ETH/HOOKR pool, and every token bought that way is burned. Creators keep 50% of collected quote-side fees after guard withholding.

HOOKR pairs
On HOOKR pairs there is no protocol fee at all and the creator keeps 100% of quote-side fees, which is a direct economic reason to quote a launch in HOOKR.

Launch Boost
Launch Boost charges a 1% fee on the gross deposit, which goes to the lock cohort.

Arbitrage Recapture
Arbitrage recapture splits what it retains 40% to the creator, 20% to the trader, 20% to LPs, 10% to @whatthehookv4 and 10% to Hookr.

Actively working on
🟪Leverage hooks, in audit, borrowing against a pool's own liquidity rather than a separate vault
🟪Gaming hooks with @V4RCADE, about to release
Lend Boost
🟪A new trader-incentive mechanic for the ETH/HOOKR pool with the @whatthehookv4 team
🟪HOOKR-paired launch options, hooks on more existing tokens, and white-labelling onto other launchpads

Project Timeline
Project Timeline
Aug 5 - Hookr announced, a launchpad with custom Uniswap hooks
Aug 6 - https://t.co/TUEAf7tGf8 goes live on Robinhood Chain and the ETH/HOOKR pool is created on Uniswap v4
Aug 7-11 - the five hook blocks ship one a day: Anti-Snipe, Surge Fees, Auto Burn, LP Rewards, Nth-Buy Pot
Aug 8 - Hookr Directory opens, every profile backed by a launch or a published blueprint
Aug 11 - an instant-liquidity launch path ships, Launch Boost is announced as the first robinhood:0x18e674231a58c239dc7daedcffe15ec3a24cff5c utility, and Leveraged Hooks are revealed
Aug 12 - @0xzaps commits 50% of 0xZaps token swap fees to market-buying and bonding robinhood:0x18e674231a58c239dc7daedcffe15ec3a24cff5c
Aug 20 - the first burner goes live, 58K HOOKR burned on day one
Aug 21 - launches deploy with @TradePools mechanics plus custom hooks, through Instant Launch or Continuous Clearing Auction, on an ETH or robinhood:0x18e674231a58c239dc7daedcffe15ec3a24cff5c pair
Aug 24 - Hook Tokens announced, a path for builders to publish and own their own blocks
Aug 25 - 1.4M HOOKR burned
Aug 26 - Hookr Builder set to open to composable blocks from across the ecosystem
Aug 29 - 2.4M HOOKR burned
Aug 31 - the Hookr hook approved by Uniswap and eligible for routing, five blocks composable
Aug 31 - Hook Analyzer introduced
Sep 2 - UI and contracts move to a new modular system with composable hook building blocks
Sep 3 - @V4RCADE partnership, where a player's score sets the fee they pay
Sep 4 - robinhood:0x18e674231a58c239dc7daedcffe15ec3a24cff5c verified on fomo, and MCAP peaks at $30.9M
Sep 6 - @whatthehookv4 arbitrage recapture brought into the modular hooks
Sep 8 - @Perpshood builds on the new modular hook
Sep 10 - new version ships: existing pairs, RWA pairs, post-launch liquidity, SDK, Outlook, Hook Connect
Sep 10 - 4M HOOKR burned, putting the burn address in the top 50 holders
Sep 17 - arbitrage recapture goes live, the first hook builder integration
Sep 19 - the ETH/HOOKR pool retains about 2.5 ETH across 961 arbs out of 3.2K+ trades
Sep 22 - 116 launches, 94 pools, $42.9M total volume
